objective: Make BUKLOD Connect caller status truthful, expose local ringback state, and report real remote foreground presentation without mistaking Stream server ring request for confirmed Android push delivery.
productionBaselineEvidence: Latest GitHub main baseline 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f inspected 2026-11-23. Prior source already included outgoing ringback, Stream call.ring, native FCM incoming channels and two separate rejection alerts. User screenshot showed indefinite Calling... without device-reach signal. No live APK/FCM device receipt or exact production OTA fingerprint verified.
chosenApproach: Single global outcome reporter; remove duplicate ConnectThread listener that calls timeout offline without evidence. Require recipient foreground client to send authenticated Stream per-call custom presentation acknowledgement before the caller can show recipient display; otherwise show server sent/unverified. Gate ringback on expo-audio readiness and surface playing/disabled status; maintain Stream-native incoming UI.
selectionRationale: The root defect is an observability gap, stale duplicate outcomes and one-shot audio playback before ready, not evidence of FCM failure. Separating server state from real recipient acknowledgement prevents false delivery claims and new native configuration risks.
alternativeApproaches: Mark call.ring as device delivered (rejected: Stream sends this server event to all call members whether Android FCM displayed a call screen or not).
Modify Android notification channel or rebuild APK (rejected: no proof push transport failed; changing native runtime risks existing working ads and PTT).
Show Calling... forever and assume ringback plays (rejected: recreates missing status and audio observability).
preserveBehaviors: Existing native Stream/Telecom/FCM incoming ringing and notification channels unchanged, including killed/background behavior.
Fresh per-attempt IDs, 45s outgoing auto-cancel and 30s incoming timeout remain intact.
Personal and scope calling, camera/mic controls, accepted-call HUD, minimized-call behavior and PTT isolation preserved.
No change to Auth/RLS, Supabase schema, native runtime, Android package, Ads or notifications.
Caller not shown delivered without foreground remote acknowledgement; missing receipt does not mean unreachable or offline.
Call audio stops on cancel, accept, background and normal terminal states without crashing disposed players.
acceptanceChecks: Source / TypeScript and automated focused tests pass on exact PR head.
Caller shows request sent/unconfirmed until exact call CID recipient foreground ACK; old/untrusted/own receipts rejected.
Ringback starts only while RINGING and audio ready; disabled and not-playing states visible without claiming remote sound.
A recipient accepting shows connected Stream call; rejected, busy and missed show one accurate caller alert without DB delay.
Original call termination crash regression and PTT/native/Ads/fast-nav tests pass.
Two Android phones validate foreground, background, killed, denied notification, weak network, no answer and busy before production release.
Idle global calling surface does not cover Home/Wall/Ads; existing ads remain mounted while a call UI is active.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: The global Stream call overlay and sound player are app-wide runtime UI elements; changing them must not disrupt other mounted screens or ads.
preservedBehaviors: Global overlays remain error-isolated and accepted calls continue to use the existing Stream call surface.
No changes to AdMob, navigation, background audio policy or Expo runtime.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Update existing personal/scope call display, remove duplicate outcome alert and add verified per-call presentation acknowledgement.
preservedBehaviors: Existing personal and scoped calling, native incoming ringtone, fresh IDs, and PTT isolation remain unchanged.
No false offline, FCM delivered or actual ringing claim without remote evidence.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Protected gate also classifies the shared BuklodConnectThread path; caller overlay changes must preserve all existing ads and finance views.
preservedBehaviors: Call status UI is mounted only for live Stream calls; it does not mount over Home, Wall or other screens while idle.
AdMob provider, fills, placements, finance and points logic remain entirely unchanged.
